states.notes: PI, WD and med mal are high confidence. Property damage: Alabama splits negligent injury to property (trespass on the case, 2 years under 6-2-38(l)) from direct trespass to personal property (6 years under 6-2-34(2)); which applies to a car-crash claim depends on how it is pleaded, so 2 years is the safe figure. Justia returned 403, so text was read from the Legislature's own ALISON data feed.
